question: How do the most skilled flocks of birds honor the lord of birds?
premises: Bird groups are most skilled in twofold motion.
They address the deity as lord of birds.
They fan him around in service.
inference: The birds express devotion by using their supreme skill in flight to serve the bird-lord.
uncertainties: dvidhā gatau may refer to specific modes of flight.
plain_english: The most skilled flocks of birds, moving in two ways, fan you around as the lord of birds.
